method: Real mouse clicks through Computer Use in a development player, isolated profile prepared with normal economy commands
observations: Opened settlement from the main menu and paused time; day remained 36 throughout the following checks.
Opened Economy, selected five deliveries, exchanged 150 wood for 100 ore: wood 212 -> 62, ore 74 -> 174.
Exchange buttons became unavailable with insufficient wood and displayed the missing amount.
Selected empty plot 20 and started a house: wood 62 -> 17, stone 288 -> 273; construction panel appeared.
Cancelled construction: wood restored to 62, stone to 288; plot returned to empty.
Selected the house on plot 7, activated relocation, selected highlighted empty plot 20; house moved, population capacity remained 28 and resources were unchanged.
Closed the isolated player normally with Alt+F4. No runtime exceptions were logged.
limitations: Android hardware and touchscreen menu clicks were not tested. The pause caption was shortened and quantity wording corrected after these clicks; final screenshots cover these text-only changes.
